name: Restaurant Equipment Company

about:
Restaurant Equipment Company (RECO) operates from Festus, Missouri, as a family-owned and operated business supplying new commercial restaurant equipment. The company was established to provide vital kitchen equipment at affordable prices, though its founding year is not publicly disclosed. Its location on U.S. 67 positions it to serve the Midwest and beyond.

RECO distributes equipment from several well-known manufacturers, covering a range of commercial kitchen needs from cooking to refrigeration. In addition to equipment sales, the company fabricates custom cutting boards to customer-specified dimensions, offering a made-to-order service for foodservice operators.

The company serves restaurants, commercial kitchens, and broader foodservice operations, providing both standard equipment and tailored cutting board solutions. Its customer base includes independent eateries and institutional foodservice buyers seeking reliable supply.

RECO emphasizes affordable pricing, durability, and reliability across its product lines, backed by partnerships with established manufacturers. The family-owned structure underscores a commitment to quality standards and customer satisfaction in every transaction.
